- Traffic pattern: heavy concentration 09:00-18:00 PT (US West); expected peak concurrency ~420 active dev sessions, ~350 reqs/sec for completions during spikes, batch jobs up to 1.5M tokens over 30m windows.
- Latency SLO: target 99th <120ms for short completions (<128 tokens) with streaming enabled (first token <40ms).

- Caching: interested in prefix/KV cache sharing across sessions for common snippets; want batching recommendations from Redwood Optimize.
